messages:
alex (support): Customer ClarityAI just escalated — embeddings usage chart on Console is showing 'units' labeled as tokens but they're actually vector counts. Customer says their bill jumped ~3x after a recent bulk upsert. Repro steps below and sample payloads. @matt (eng) @jordan (analytics) :eyes:

matt (eng): Thanks, can you paste the exact API call and a screenshot of the chart? Also any request IDs or example events from our ingestion logs will help.

alex (support): Screenshot attached to the ticket (internal link). Minimal repro to see the issue:

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-1024","input":["doc1","doc2","doc3"],"metadata":{"customer":"clarityai"}}'
```

Sample response from the API (trimmed):
```
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [ {"embedding": [..1024 floats..], "index":0}, {"embedding": [...],"index":1}, {"embedding": [...],"index":2} ],
  "usage": {"vectors":3, "tokens":1024}
}
```

alex (support): Notice 'usage' contains both vectors and tokens. The Console's embeddings chart is using the wrong usage field and is labeled 'tokens' — so it displays 1024 units instead of 3, and an additional ETL duplication makes it look like ~3x.

jordan (analytics): I pulled the ingestion logs for clarityai for the window they reported (2026-01-15 02:10–02:16 UTC). Two things: a recent mapping change in the metrics ETL changed the unit attribute mapping from "metric.units_type" -> "vectors" to a generic "units" fallback; and our dedupe key was based on request_id which the SDK splits across chunked upserts, so the same logical upsert is getting recorded multiple times. Example event (ingest log):

```
{ "ts": "2026-01-15T02:12:01Z", "customer":"clarityai", "event":"embeddings_generated", "units":1024, "units_type":"tokens", "request_id":"r-abc-1" }
{ "ts": "2026-01-15T02:12:02Z", "customer":"clarityai", "event":"embeddings_generated", "units":1, "units_type":"vectors", "request_id":"r-abc-1-chunk-1" }
{ "ts": "2026-01-15T02:12:02Z", "customer":"clarityai", "event":"embeddings_generated", "units":1, "units_type":"vectors", "request_id":"r-abc-1-chunk-2" }
```

jordan (analytics): So the UI chart pulls the numeric "units" column and labels it "tokens" in the legend. When upstream started emitting both vectors and tokens in different fields we ended up with mixed semantics. The chunking without a canonical dedupe id is causing the apparent multiplication.

matt (eng): Got it. Looks like two fixes: 1) ETL mapping should prefer explicit units_type and normalize to a canonical numeric column (vectors_count vs tokens_count) instead of a generic "units"; 2) dedupe key should use a stable upload_id if present (or hash(customer+file_sha+timestamp+batch_index)) so chunked requests don't double-count. I'll open a patch.

sara (product): We need to triage billing impact and offer ClarityAI a credit if we confirm incorrect charges. Matt, can you estimate scope? Jordan, can you quantify how many customers hit this pattern in the last 7 days?

jordan (analytics): Preliminary query: customers with mixed units_type events in the last 7 days = 6 customers, ClarityAI = largest spike (accounted for ~58% of the apparent extra units). I'll run a full backfill to compute overstated units and share numbers in ~2 hours.

matt (eng): Quick patch plan: (a) ETL mapping PR to prefer units_type and populate tokens_count|vectors_count fields + unit_enum; (b) add dedupe by upload_id/hash; (c) add regression test with chunked upserts. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/analytics/pull/452 (WIP). I'll request review and schedule hotfix deploy to staging.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline triggered for branch embed-units-fix. Status: tests running :progress_bar:.

alex (support): I'll reply to ClarityAI with interim update: acknowledging the issue, that we're investigating and will provide a timeline and potential credit. I'll ask them to hold on any further bulk uploads until we confirm.

matt (eng): If Jordan's backfill confirms only these 6 customers were affected, we can perform a targeted billing correction and push a Console label fix to avoid confusing 'units' with tokens. Also adding a tooltip clarifying what chart shows (vectors vs tokens).

sara (product): Good. Please loop in billing ops once Jordan has the backfill numbers. Also schedule a post-mortem once hotfix is deployed.

alex (support): Will do. Thanks all.

-- end thread --
